name: 陳涵秀
objective:
本課程分為三大部分，其一為探討文化資產保存的概念及相關議題；其二為講授文化資產資源應用所需的研究方法和工具－田野調查，並進行實務練習；其三為結合大學社會責任概念，透過和場域的合作，引導學生將理論概念透過不同的方式，應用相關工具和資源，將文化保存落實於社會場域中。
This course aims to understand the concept of heritage preservation and different issues related to the conservation, preservation and reinterpretation of cultural resources. Moreover, fieldwork, the research methods of doing heritage preservation and resource management is also taught in this course. Finally, by cooperating with USR project, students are involved in diverse cases of heritage preservation, and apply the theory to practice

15. Management your cultural project / 文化提案二次優化 
16. Discussion / 綜合討論與檢討
